column1: ## Repository Table R14. Adaptive allele scores at individual loci

## Description: Native log probabilities and differences. Positive differences favour the reported selected allele; magnitudes are not calibrated fitness effects and are not comparable across model score scales. Allele directions are supported by literature and explicit ancestral/strand checks.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Model | Evaluated checkpoint display name, harmonized with the figures.
## Column 2 | Variant | Variant for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Chromosome | Chromosome for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | GRCh38 position (1-based) | Single-base genomic position using the one-based GRCh38 coordinate system.
## Column 5 | Gene or locus | Gene or locus for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 6 | Selected allele | Selected allele for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 7 | Alternative allele | Alternative allele for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 8 | Reported population | Reported population for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 9 | Selected allele log probability | Selected allele log probability for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 10 | Alternative allele log probability | Alternative allele log probability for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 11 | Selected-minus-alternative score | Native selected-allele log probability minus alternative-allele log probability.
## Column 12 | Selected allele preferred | Selected allele preferred for the observation defined in the table description.
